title: Enable Ethernet interface
summary: Bring a disabled Ethernet interface up if it has no link light or is down.

steps.cmd: sudo ip link set dev <INTERFACE> up

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the Ethernet interface (e.g., eth0, enp34s0).

steps.expect: The interface state changes to UP.

rollback.cmd: sudo ip link set dev <INTERFACE> down

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the Ethernet interface (e.g., eth0, enp34s0).

warnings: Ensure the cable is connected before enabling the interface.
